dedupe_keys.name: strategic green infrastructure and ecosystem restoration geospatial methods data and tools jrc and eea 2019

description: This joint science for policy report reviews geospatial methods, datasets and tools for mapping green infrastructure and planning ecosystem restoration in the European Union, and demonstrates them with Europe-wide maps. Christine Estreguil, Gorm Dige, Stefan Kleeschulte, Hugo Carrao, Jean Raynal and Anne Teller wrote it for the Joint Research Centre, the European Environment Agency, the European Topic Centre on Urban, Land and Soil Systems and DG Environment (EUR 29449 EN, 2019). It sets out concepts of green infrastructure and the knowledge base for measuring ecosystem services, catalogues datasets and tools for physical and ecosystem-service-based mapping, and applies them to questions such as whether protected area systems support connectivity, the functional connectivity of the EU network and riparian corridors. Coverage is the EU. Format and access: a 127-page PDF with a DOI. Licence: European Commission reuse policy, reuse allowed with acknowledgement; free. Caveats: the maps are illustrations in the report, not separate downloadable layers. It guides strategic green infrastructure planning at European scale. Related catalogue records are the LUIGI Alpine green infrastructure maps and the Natural England green infrastructure mapping database.
